construct_ontology: ADHD symptoms in children and adolescents

metadata.description: German diagnostic-system reference with observer forms for ADHD symptoms in children and adolescents.
metadata.intended_use: Multi-informant assessment in child and adolescent clinical, educational, and research settings.
metadata.name_origin: DISYPS is the German diagnostic system for mental disorders in children and adolescents; FBB-ADHS is its Fremdbeurteilungsbogen for ADHD.
metadata.development_history: Developed as a German age- and disorder-specific system with parent and teacher assessment forms.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Combining observer ratings with clinical information helps assess ADHD symptoms across settings and developmental contexts.
metadata.interpretation_notes: The questionnaire does not replace a full diagnostic process; use the exact DISYPS edition, informant form, norms, and clinical manual.

versions.source_citation: Döpfner and Görtz-Dorten. DISYPS-III: Diagnostik-System für psychische Störungen nach ICD-10 und DSM-5 bei Kindern und Jugendlichen.

source_documents.title: DISYPS-III German diagnostic system reference
source_documents.license_name: Commercial diagnostic system; edition and use terms apply
source_documents.permission_basis: Only discovery and bibliographic metadata is stored. Item wording and forms are excluded until the exact German version and reuse terms are verified.
